capabilities: Connect the vault to Claude Code via an MCP server over WebSocket
Share open files and the current selection with the CLI in real time
Send selected text to Claude as explicit context
Authenticate local connections with a per-session token
disambiguation: Not a coding IDE; despite the name it only passes open-file and selection context to Claude Code, which edits files directly with no diff view.
extras: Desktop only — it needs Node.js APIs Obsidian mobile lacks. The FAQ warns that Claude Code sends prompts and context to Anthropic's API, so private vaults should use a separate project vault. The WebSocket server is localhost-only with per-session auth and read-only context sharing.
intentEvidence: obsidian-claude-code-mcp — all-in-one alternative: embedded terminal, Claude Desktop support
problem: Claude Code can already read and edit vault files, but it cannot see which note is open or what text is selected in the Obsidian editor.

relations.evidence: Minimal bridge between Obsidian and Claude Code — shares real-time editor context with the CLI
Neovim integration, protocol documentation that made this plugin possible
all-in-one alternative: embedded terminal, Claude Desktop support
Obsidian CLI lets Claude Code run commands — open files, search the vault, rename with automatic link updates

summary: Bridge that connects Obsidian to the Claude Code CLI, sharing real-time editor context such as open files and text selections over a local MCP server.
